title: drosera filiformis var. tracyi
intro: Drosera filiformis var. tracyi, commonly known as the thread-leaved sundew, is a carnivorous plant species native to North America. It has been used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Drosera filiformis var. tracyi include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and alleviate anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
